**Method summary & result:** 3301 sea cells (finite SST on all target days) were identified out of 3600 region cells. Per-cell thresholds (90th percentile, numpy `method="hazen"`) and climatology means were built from 121-value ±5-day baseline pools for each day of year, day 60 set to the mean of days 59/61, then 31-day centred wrap-around smoothing was applied to both 366-day arrays (all in float64; every step verified: pool extraction, hazen formula against numpy's source, wrap-around window means, doy mapping, and the run/gap-joining logic against hand-crafted cases). Over the target period, SST stayed below the smoothed 90th-percentile threshold almost everywhere: the maximum SST (294.11 K ≈ 21.0 °C) never exceeded the threshold for ≥5 consecutive days in any sea cell — only six isolated hot cell-days occurred (Aug 1, 4, 5). Hence **no per-cell MHWs and no regional MHW events** in this region for June–August 2004.
